pos.personaBrief: Chelsea 2016-18 did not seek the ball: Bola na Rede says it is not a team that wants possession and slows counters, yet FourFourTwo notes controlling late games. Vertical pace with Costa, Hazard and wing-backs made space behind the defence the aim.

pro.personaBrief: Verified evidence shows long balls under Spurs' press, Luiz's long passing, direct deep passes to the wing-backs and runs by the back-three centre-backs. Conte's stated aim was balance, and he put solidity first.

est.personaBrief: The 3-4-2-1 had fixed, drilled roles, with wing-backs holding the width and a spread shape. The striker linked play, and Hazard and Willian worked between the lines.

lar.personaBrief: Chelsea won through Alonso and Moses as wing-backs plus the two number 10s, with no classic wingers (Premier League, FourFourTwo). Width came from the wing-backs and crossing.

blo.personaBrief: Chelsea pressed with intent, with Conte shouting 'Go, go, go' to his forwards and Kante's 127 tackles, but Bola na Rede describes zonal, controlled defending with no frantic counterpressing. It was a mid-high block, not a deep one.

mar.personaBrief: Bola na Rede describes zonal defending by ball position, with a centre-back stepping out to the ball carrier. Conte's teams are otherwise man-oriented, and there is no verified source on Chelsea corners.

pla.personaBrief: After the Arsenal defeat Conte changed system, going from a 4-2-4 to a 3-4-3 to fit his squad. This shows adaptation, but the 3-4-3 then stayed constant for most opponents.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic and win-first: the switch was made to stop conceding, he wants balance, and he closes out games. The title was won with control and efficiency, not spectacle.

sis.personaBrief: Conte drilled a system with defined tasks for everyone, stars included. Costa was frozen out in the feud, and Hazard and Willian worked within the 3-4-2-1.

jog.personaBrief: Conte wanted athletic, intense players: Kante, Moses reinvented as a wing-back, Matic, and 8.54km more distance run against United. No classic number 10 was used.

bas.personaBrief: Title-winning team built on experienced signings and players like Terry, Cahill and Azpilicueta, though in 2017/18 Conte said he wanted to lower the average age (Christensen, Bakayoko, Morata). Academy products had no priority.

lid.personaBrief: Conte was an authoritarian: he dropped Terry and Ivanovic on form, feuded with Costa and clashed with the club. He describes himself as frank like Trapattoni, preferring a hard truth to a comforting lie.
